chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Fudayl ibn Yasar and Burayd ibn Muawiyah and Zurarah, that Abd al-Malik ibn A'yan said:
To Abu Abdillah عليه السلام: The Zaydiyyah and the Mu'tazilah have gathered around Muhammad ibn Abd Allah, so does he have authority?
So he عليه السلام said: By Allah, with me are two books in which is the naming of every Prophet and every king who will rule the earth.
No, by Allah, Muhammad ibn Abd Allah is not in either one of them.

key_terms.الزَّيْدِيَّةَ: the Zaydi group mentioned as supporting Muhammad ibn Abd Allah
key_terms.الْمُعْتَزِلَةَ: the Mu'tazili group mentioned in the report
key_terms.تَسْمِيَةُ: the naming or explicit mention of persons
key_terms.لَكِتَابَيْنِ: two books possessed by the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.وَاحِدٍ: either one of the two books

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام respond to claims about the authority of Muhammad ibn Abd Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rejecting the claim of authority for Muhammad ibn Abd Allah by referring to divinely inherited books containing the names of Prophets and earthly rulers. The narration highlights the Imam's special knowledge and serves as a criterion for distinguishing true religious authority from unsupported political claims.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his fathr, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Fuzayl Bin Yasaar and Bureyd Bin Muawiya and Zurara that, 
‘Abdulah Malik Bin Ayn said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The Zaydiites and the Mu’tazilites are circling around Muhammad Bin Abdullah, so it there an authority for him?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! With me<sup>asws</sup> are two Books wherein is named every Prophet<sup>as</sup>, and every king who would be a king of the earth.
No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Muhammad Bin Abdullah is not in any one of these two’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn Udhayna from Fudayl ibn Yasar, Burayd ibn Mu‘wiya and Zurarah who have said that ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Abd al-Malik said the following to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.),
“The Zaydi sect and al-Mu‘tazali group circle around Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah. Does he have any authority?”
The Imam (a.s.) said, “I swear by Allah that with me there are two books in which there is the name of every prophet and the name of every king that would rule on earth.
No, I swear by Allah, the name of Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah is not in the list as one of them.”
